clue.text: The goddess of retribution could make sin seem dreadful

indicators.note: dreadful suggests something wrecked or mangled, so the letters of sin seem are rearranged

explanation.surface: Retribution personified could make wrongdoing look terrible.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dreadful' shuffles the seven letters of SIN SEEM; 'could make' links the definition to the wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth Nemesis is the deity who punishes arrogance and wrongdoing.

clue.text: Unnecessary curtailing of sharps

indicators.note: curtailing means cutting the tail, so the final letter of the synonym is dropped

parts.note: needless means unnecessary

explanation.surface: A pointless shortening of musical sharps.
explanation.walkthrough: 'curtailing' removes the last S of NEEDLESS. 'sharps' suggests music but means sharp points.
explanation.definitionFit: Sewing pins and similar pointed objects are sharp things.

clue.text: To some degree rave over a beautiful house-plant

indicators.note: in a down clue, over means on top of, so rant sits above the A

parts.note: MA is a Master of Arts degree
to rave is to rant

explanation.surface: To an extent, enthuse about a lovely indoor plant.
explanation.walkthrough: 'To some degree' looks like a hidden-word signal, but it gives MA; 'To' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A tropical prayer plant with patterned leaves, often grown indoors.

clue.text: Smart, virtuous man getting in before midnight

indicators.note: before means placed ahead of, so the letters come ahead of the final piece

parts.note: ST is the abbreviation for saint, a virtuous man
the middle letter of night is G

explanation.surface: A clever good man arrives home before twelve.
explanation.walkthrough: 'midnight' is read as the middle of the word night, its letter G.
explanation.definitionFit: To sting is to hurt with a sharp burning pain, as a cut may smart.

clue.text: The more distinguished person making gestures?

definitions.meaning: signal means notable or outstanding, so its comparative means more notable
one who sends messages by signs

explanation.surface: Is the higher-ranking one the one waving arms?
explanation.definitionFit: Signal as an adjective means striking, giving a comparative form; also one who sends messages by flags or signs.

clue.text: Tick is imperative

definitions.meaning: a tick is a very short moment of time
imperative means urgent or pressing, as a demand may be

explanation.surface: A tick mark is compulsory.
explanation.definitionFit: As a noun the word is a moment, like a tick; as an adjective it means urgent or immediate, close to imperative.

clue.text: A woman getting behind is put out

indicators.note: getting behind means coming after, so the woman follows the word is

parts.note: Sue is a woman's name

explanation.surface: A woman trailing is annoyed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'put out' looks like 'annoyed', but means publish.
explanation.definitionFit: To publish or release something is to bring it out officially.

clue.text: Breaking dates hastily, is really single-minded

indicators.note: breaking means smashing up, so the letters of dates are rearranged

parts.note: fast means quickly, hastily

explanation.surface: Someone who quickly breaks off dates is truly determined.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Breaking' rearranges DATES to STEAD; 'is really' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Being firm and unwavering in purpose is resolute determination.

clue.text: Encouraged by article, took a chance

parts.note: a is the indefinite article
betted means gambled, took a chance

explanation.surface: Spurred on by a newspaper piece, someone gambled.
explanation.walkthrough: 'article' is the grammatical word A, not a newspaper piece.
explanation.definitionFit: Aided and supported, often in wrongdoing, is to have been encouraged.

clue.text: Traditional oven to include as well as the alternative

indicators.note: include means hold inside, so the word to is split around the next piece

parts.note: taken as written
as well as means and
or offers an alternative

explanation.surface: An old-style stove, to take in as well as the other choice.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to include' reads like an instruction, but TO is the container and 'include' the signal; a tandoor is the clay oven of Indian cooking.
explanation.definitionFit: A clay oven used in Indian cooking is a traditional cooking device.

clue.text: This depends on the listener

parts.note: depends is read literally as hangs down from, and the listener is an ear, so this is jewellery hanging from an ear

explanation.definitionFit: A piece of jewellery worn hanging from the lobe of the ear, the organ of hearing.

clue.text: The woman visited an illicit drinking place

parts.note: the woman is she
to have been somewhere is to have visited it

explanation.surface: A woman went to an unlicensed bar.
explanation.walkthrough: A shebeen is an Irish and Scottish word for an unlicensed bar.
explanation.definitionFit: Originally Irish, the word names an unlicensed house selling alcohol.

clue.text: Count the money and be serious

parts.note: L is the abbreviation for pounds, British money
grave means serious

explanation.surface: Tally up the cash and look solemn.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Count' looks like a verb, but it is the noun: a German nobleman. 'the' and 'be' are link words.
explanation.definitionFit: A landgrave was a German count ruling a territory, a title of nobility.

clue.text: Hundreds adapt to it just the same

parts.note: D is the Roman numeral for five hundred, standing for hundreds

indicators.note: to adapt something is to alter it, so the letters of to it are rearranged

explanation.surface: Hundreds of people adjust to it equally.
explanation.walkthrough: 'adapt' turns TO IT into ITTO, placed after D.
explanation.definitionFit: The word is used to say the same again, repeating what came before.

clue.text: Sovereign power, say

definitions.meaning: a sovereign power is an independent nation
to say is to declare or put into words

explanation.surface: A ruler's authority, for instance.
explanation.definitionFit: A nation with sovereignty is one sense; to declare in words is the verb sense.

clue.text: They're supposed to remember the plane's lay-out

indicators.note: a layout is an arrangement, so the letters of the plane's are set out afresh

parts.note: the letters of plane plus the s

explanation.surface: They're said to recall the aircraft's floor plan.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lay-out' rearranges THE PLANES, the possessive S counting as a letter here.
explanation.definitionFit: Proverbially large animals with trunks never forget.

clue.text: Two foreign articles about plan for Northerner

indicators.note: about means around, so the two articles go round the word plan

parts.note: la is French for the and der is German for the
der is the German masculine article
taken as written

explanation.surface: Two newspaper pieces from abroad concerning a scheme for someone from the north.
explanation.walkthrough: 'articles' means grammatical words for 'the', not newspaper stories: LA (French) and DER (German) surround PLAN.
explanation.definitionFit: A native of Lapland in the far north of Scandinavia is a northern person.

clue.text: Very agreeable associate on a board

parts.note: a pal is a friend, an associate
a board is a table, as in bed and board

explanation.surface: A very pleasant colleague sitting on a committee.
explanation.walkthrough: 'board' suggests a committee but means a table; 'on' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Pleasant to taste or acceptable, so much to one's liking.

clue.text: The card possibly inscribed by a novice for the church

indicators.note: inscribed by means signed by, so the signature letters follow the shuffled card
possibly signals that the letters of the card may be arranged another way

parts.note: L is a learner, as on British learner-driver plates

explanation.surface: A card perhaps written by a beginner for the parish church.
explanation.walkthrough: 'possibly' rearranges THE CARD to CATHEDR; 'inscribed by' adds A and L (learner) as a signature at the end.
explanation.definitionFit: A great principal church containing a bishop's throne.

clue.text: It's many a girl Edward put in her place!

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for a hundred, many
a lass is a girl
Ed is short for Edward

explanation.surface: Many a girl was firmly put down by Edward!
explanation.walkthrough: 'put in her place' suggests a rebuke, but means sorted into a category.
explanation.definitionFit: Assigned to a category or rank, to be graded.

clue.text: Identifying a winger with a swimmer

parts.note: a tit is a small bird, a winger
ling is a fish, a swimmer

explanation.surface: Picking out a wing player together with someone in the pool.
explanation.walkthrough: 'winger' suggests a sports player but is a bird.
explanation.definitionFit: Giving a name or heading to something labels it.

clue.text: Dressed, though weary

definitions.meaning: an old word meaning attired or clothed
weary means worn out or exhausted

explanation.surface: Smartly clothed, yet exhausted.
explanation.definitionFit: An archaic past tense of tire, meaning to attire, gives clothed; the common sense is worn out.

clue.text: He faces facts concerning a heel

parts.note: re means concerning, about
to heel is to lean over, as a ship lists

explanation.surface: Someone facing the truth about a scoundrel.
explanation.walkthrough: 'heel' suggests a cad but means to lean, as a ship does.
explanation.definitionFit: A pragmatic person accepts the way things truly are.

clue.text: Craft gives the medico some advantage, right?

parts.note: DR stands for doctor, a medico
an edge is some advantage

explanation.surface: A vessel gives the doctor a slight lead, correct?
explanation.walkthrough: 'Craft' is a boat, not a skill.
explanation.definitionFit: A vessel that scoops mud from riverbeds is a type of boat.

clue.text: A letter some await cheerfully enough

indicators.note: some means a portion, so part of the words await cheerfully supplies the letters

explanation.surface: Some people wait gladly enough for a letter in the post.
explanation.walkthrough: 'enough' is padding for the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: The spelled-out name of the eighth letter of the alphabet, H.

clue.text: Big shot offering dope in French art-gallery

parts.note: pot is slang for cannabis, dope
en is French for in
the Tate is a famous London art gallery

explanation.surface: An important person offers drugs in a Paris gallery.
explanation.walkthrough: THE TATE is a group of art galleries in Britain, chiefly in London.
explanation.definitionFit: A powerful ruler or monarch, a very important person.

clue.text: The little page put on airs working in the city

indicators.note: put on means placed above, so the page sits ahead of the rest in this down entry

parts.note: P is the abbreviation for page

indicators.note: working means in operation or being worked, so the letters of airs are rearranged

explanation.surface: The young pageboy showed off while employed in the capital.
explanation.walkthrough: 'put on airs' looks like a phrase for showing off; 'working' rearranges AIRS.
explanation.definitionFit: The capital of France is a city.

clue.text: A pensioner very often exhibits great courage

indicators.note: exhibits means shows, so the letters are displayed within pensioner very

explanation.surface: An old person frequently displays bravery.
explanation.walkthrough: 'often' is padding for the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: Boldness or daring is a form of bravery.

clue.text: Turner, a delinquent pocketing the small change

indicators.note: pocketing means taking inside, so the change goes within the delinquent

parts.note: a sinner is a wrongdoer, a delinquent
P stands for a penny, small British change

explanation.surface: An offender who switched sides, a youth stealing loose coins.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Turner' suggests the painter, but it is something that turns: a spinner. 'pocketing' puts P inside SINNER.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that spins, such as a top or a spin bowler, is one that turns.

clue.text: Prevent the top man creating a beastly row

parts.note: to bar is to prevent
a king is the top man in a kingdom

explanation.surface: Stop the leader from starting an awful argument.
explanation.walkthrough: 'beastly row' is noise from a beast, a dog, not a quarrel.
explanation.definitionFit: A dog's loud noise is barking, so this is an animal making a racket.

clue.text: Abstracts and deals with the intake

definitions.meaning: abstracts are summaries of longer texts
the stomach processes food taken in

explanation.surface: Summaries that handle what has been taken in.
explanation.definitionFit: Summaries of writing are one sense; the body breaking down food it has eaten is the verb sense.

clue.text: A foreign prince making one cross?

definitions.meaning: a German prince entitled to help choose the Holy Roman Emperor
a voter makes a cross on a ballot paper

explanation.surface: A prince from abroad who angers someone?
explanation.definitionFit: Historic German princes chose the emperor; a modern voter marks a cross on the ballot.
